title: A reception for visiting groups

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: The client's note says to keep the reception light. I nearly cut the order. The order includes one serving for each blue badge. The later tour group has blue badges too.
turns.zh: 客戶的備註說招待會要簡便，我差點把訂單份數減掉。但訂單按每張藍色識別證各包含一份餐點，較晚參觀的團體也拿藍證。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: That sketch is for the tours. They need the middle clear in both directions. The ledge will hold one tray; the prep room is free until the last tour finishes.
turns.zh: 那張草圖是給參觀團用的。中央通道兩個方向都要保持暢通。檯面放得下一盤，備餐室可以用到最後一團參觀結束。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Both narrow stands fit the ledge. The deep one needs a table. Yesterday's sample plate didn't wobble on the narrow stand with the rail, did it?
turns.zh: 兩款窄架都放得上檯面，深架需要桌子。昨天的樣品盤在有擋條的窄架上沒有搖晃，對吧？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: No. That plate's foot was in the middle. The rail sits under the back edge of the plate, with no clearance for a foot there. The plain stand is flat right to the back.
turns.zh: 沒有。那個盤子的腳座在中央。擋條就在盤子後緣下方，那裡沒有空間容納腳座。沒有擋條的架子一直到後緣都是平的。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: The client wants her own plates. In this photo the foot touches the back rim. Ah, and she just issued two more blue badges. At four I signed for the thirty badges she'd issued by then. I haven't put these two on any sheet.
turns.zh: 客戶要用自己的盤子。這張照片裡，腳座貼到後緣。啊，她剛又發了兩張藍證。四點時我簽核了她當時已發出的三十張。這兩張還沒有寫到任何單據上。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: You leave at four twenty, right? The runner comes ten minutes later. The kitchen sends out the number you sign for, not the total on the badge screen.
turns.zh: 你四點二十分離開，對吧？送餐人員晚十分鐘才到。廚房依你簽核的份數出餐，不是看發證畫面顯示的總數。
